A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same LeviTor study, with readable text, equations, tables, figures and appendices. Existing appendix content can be matched despite relocation and figure renumbering.

before.justification: v1 reports original DAVIS evaluations, qualitative video-generation comparisons, component ablations, and appendix single-point-control and failure-case studies.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results and adds qualitative comparisons with SG-I2V and MOFA-Video in Appendix A.

M1.justification: The clustered mask-point representation, depth and instance conditioning, SVD/ControlNet training, and mask-rendering inference pipeline remain unchanged. Section 3.2 changes the mask-count symbol from N to X without changing the procedure.

E1.justification: SA-V training and DAVIS evaluation remain unchanged. The new ball-motion illustration exercises complex trajectory and depth control already covered by existing examples; it does not establish a distinct dataset, domain or task extension.

E2.justification: Appendix A adds SG-I2V and MOFA-Video as evaluated comparators in one qualitative example. DragAnything and DragNUWA remain the main comparison methods, and Table 1's quantitative comparator set is unchanged.

E3.justification: Both versions report the same 16-frame, 288×512 training clips, 200K iterations, preprocessing, DAVIS evaluation, Co-Tracker tracking, metrics and single-/multi-point settings. The additional qualitative comparison introduces no documented change in evaluation procedure.

E4.justification: The depth/instance ablations, control-point-density analysis, single-point-control study and horse/elephant failure cases retain the same evidence. Appendix B–D are preserved, with Figures S1–S3 renumbered S2–S4.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seed counts, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. Both retain the same reporting practice of individual FID, FVD and ObjMC values.

E6.justification: New Figure S1 reports qualitative failures of SG-I2V and MOFA-Video in following the illustrated complex trajectory or depth variation. All numerical entries in Tables 1, 2 and S1 are unchanged, including LeviTor's multi-point FID/FVD/ObjMC values of 25.41/190.44/25.97.

T1.justification: Equations 1–8, the fixed-camera assumptions, training loss and geometric transformations are unchanged. The N-to-X notation correction does not alter a mathematical definition or introduce new reasoning or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the central contributions: depth-augmented clustered points for 3D trajectory control and an accessible interactive inference pipeline. The first-of-its-kind claim and claimed qualitative and quantitative advantages remain.

C2.justification: The conclusion newly states dependence on SAM segmentation and user trajectories, lack of autonomous physical-motion understanding, and inability to control internal poses. Section 4.2 replaces references to physical laws with perspective-projection rules. Existing SVD-related failure limitations remain in Appendix D.

D1.justification: The abstract replaces the project-page link with an explicit code-availability statement and repository link. Earlier instructions for opening supplementary HTML and refreshing unsynchronized GIFs are removed. Implementation and training details otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds eight references, including controllable image-editing work, 3D-TrajMaster, SG-I2V and MOFA-Video. Section 2.2 briefly acknowledges 3D-TrajMaster's 6DoF multi-entity control, extending the research context without substantially rewriting the positioning.

P1.justification: v2 tightens several experimental explanations, expands the conclusion, adds an affiliation and acknowledgements, and places the appendix before the references. The main section sequence and most prose remain intact.

P2.justification: v2 adds qualitative Figure S1, renumbers existing appendix figures, and rearranges their placement. Figure 8 moves beneath Figure 7 and gains a caption defining Scale; Table 2's placement and emphasis also change. Existing experimental graphics are largely retained.

improvement.justification: v2 improves transparency through explicit applicability limitations and a direct code link, while adding relevant research context and two qualitative baselines. These gains are limited: the additional comparison comprises one illustrated example, and the method, quantitative results and statistical support remain unchanged.
